text: You have decided to look for props in the Pirates' Hideout\nto disguise yourselves as pirates.\nGo to the Pirates' Hideout now!
Suddenly, you hear a boy and a girl screaming from\nthe Pirates' Hideout! Hurry to the Pirates' Hideout!
The boy and the girl have been attacked by Captain Stormun,\na shark-human pirate!\nDefeat him with all your might!
